products.name: Nivis Labs UV Aqua Sunscreen Spray SPF 50
products.subtitle: Nivis Labs UV Aqua Sunscreen Spray SPF 50 PA++++ is a high-protection, broad-spectrum sunscreen specially formulated for humid and hot climates. Designed with a non-greasy, fast-drying spray lotion formula, it absorbs effortlessly without leaving a sticky residue or white cast. Enriched with Octocrylene, Olive Oil, Suncat DE 5%, and Uvinul A Plus, this sunscreen offers advanced UVA/UVB protection while keeping skin hydrated. It is suitable for reapplication over makeup and ideal for oily and acne-prone skin.

products.name: UV Aqua Sunscreen Spray
products.subtitle: UV Aqua Sunscreen Spray is a lightweight, water-based sun protection mist designed to shield your skin from harmful UVA and UVB rays. Its aqua-fresh formula spreads evenly, absorbs quickly, and leaves a non-greasy, refreshing finish without any white cast. Ideal for daily outdoor protection, it helps prevent sunburn, tanning, and premature aging while keeping your skin cool, hydrated, and comfortable. Perfect for all skin types and easy reapplication anytime, anywhere.
